svg.text: Standard doser auger: section through the axis, drawn to scale. Dimensions in mm.
open Ø21 bore (reservoir): no core, no flight
cap thread: Ø26 crest on Ø23 neck, 3.5 pitch, RH
Detail: the outlet end, at 3× the scale above
flight starts at the outlet face
0.5 thick axially; from the core to the bore, and down
the funnel to the outlet face
solid Ø8 from z 12 to 83.33; a cone below it, from Ø0.8
at the outlet face to Ø8 at z 12
Ø3 hole around the Ø0.8 core tip: a 6.6 mm² annulus
spur, 44 teeth, module 1, 20° pressure angle; tip Ø46,
pitch Ø44, root Ø41.7; 10 wide, z 78.33 to 88.33. Meshes the
20-tooth stepper pinion, axes 32 apart: 2.2 stepper turns per turn
for the cap: right-handed, 3.5 pitch, Ø26 crest on a Ø23
neck from z 225 to 250; the first crest is at z 223.35
separate part: Ø29 × 27, 25 deep, Ø23.5 bore
79 mL to the open end: funnel 1.3, flighted section 20.1,
53.3 cm³; printed outlet-down, nozzle 0.4 mm or smaller
Cut on the +X half-plane (drawn above the axis) and on -X (below). z = 0 at the outlet.
From the #193 Onshape Auger's feature list (PR #200's branch), built from auger.fs (#172).
